title: HITAG 2 RFID Cards
description: HITAG 2 cards for secure 125 kHz access control, parking and mobility credentials, with cryptographic challenge-response for protected LF deployments.
summary: HITAG 2 cards provide a more secure low-frequency credential option for access, parking and mobility systems that need cryptographic protection beyond basic LF cards.
Bidirectionally: Data is transmitted bidirectionally, in half-duplex mode, between the Read-Write Device (RWD) and the HITAG transponder IC.
Cryptographic Security: HITAG 2 employs cryptographic algorithms to prevent unauthorized cloning or tampering.

faq.question: What are HITAG 2 RFID Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for protected low-frequency access, parking, mobility, and credential programs that need stronger LF security than basic read-only cards.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for HITAG 2 RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: HITAG 2 Frequency: 125 kHz Read Range: 2-10cm depending on readers

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for HITAG 2 RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PVC, PET, PETG, ABS Size: CR80 (85.5*54mm) or Custom Color: Customizable

faq.question: How can HITAG 2 RFID Cards be customized?
faq.answer: Printing Options: Silk-screen printing, CMYK full color, Pantone, digital printing, etc. Finishing Options: number printing, Laser Engraving, DOD, Bar code, QR code, magnetic stripe, encoding, etc.
